_doc: Maps UE-mannequin-style humanoid bone names (used by the Quaternius Universal Base Characters / Universal Animation Library rig family, CC0) onto SWAYHumanoid-v1. Matching is case-insensitive and tolerant of _l/_L/.L suffixes. EXACT bone names in the downloaded pack are DISCOVERED at conversion time and any of the 23 contract joints left unmapped makes conversion FAIL (never guessed).
weightMergeRule: Every deform bone that is not one of the 23 contract joints (fingers, twist, jaw, eyes, extra spine/neck) has its vertex weights added to its nearest mapped ANCESTOR, then limited to 4 influences and normalised.
